visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair and glasses, wearing a black and white striped shirt and black pants, stands in a large indoor car showroom. He holds a silver aluminum briefcase toward the camera. (2) He opens the briefcase to reveal several sets of car keys. He introduces a silver Lexus NX300, pointing at its front grille and headlights. The showroom has industrial lighting and a polished floor. (3) The man moves to a black Lexus RX, highlighting its size and exterior design. He gestures toward a 360-degree camera on the side mirror. (4) He then presents a white Toyota Supra, touching the Toyota logo on the hood and discussing its sporty features. The camera follows him with handheld movements. (5) The man showcases a black BMW 135i, opening the door to show a vibrant red leather interior with racing-style bucket seats. (6) Finally, he reaches a white BMW 235 Racing car. He struggles to climb through the window and over the complex roll cage of the stripped-out interior, eventually exiting through the door with some physical effort while laughing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a high-energy male speaker presenting in Traditional Chinese with animated pitch variability and positive valence. A sharp, distinct metallic click of a suitcase latch opening is clearly audible. The background music is an upbeat electronic dance track with a strong 4/4 rhythmic pulse and synthesized melodic textures. (2) A bright 'ding' sound effect highlights the transition to the first vehicle. The speaker maintains a rapid speech rate. The acoustic environment has a slight indoor room tone, but vocal clarity is high. A heavy mechanical thud and latching sound of a car door opening is heard, accompanied by a subtle clothing rustle as the host moves. (3) Another high-pitched 'ding' SFX punctuates the mention of pricing. The speaker's volume is moderate and conversational but projected. The background music continues without interruption. The sound of a second car door unlatching and a light metallic tap against the car's body are perceptible. (4) The audio features a rapid series of 'ding' sound effects synchronized with visual data points. The host's voice remains dominant in the mix. A hollow, percussive thud of a hood being closed is followed by a momentary swell in the background music. (5) The final phase is marked by a comedic 'laugh track' sound effect. The speaker's voice shows higher vocal tension and strain as he grunts slightly. Multiple loud, metallic clanging and banging noises occur, suggesting physical struggle against a metal structure. The session ends with a concluding humorous remark and fading BGM.
